objections.reviewer_objection: The method may be only classification or lookup over five registered garments.
objections.current_evidence: B2 is true outfit-ID lookup; B6, B7, M3, and Ours-v2 are not final.
objections.missing_evidence: Contract-clean lookup/classification and continuous-control comparisons under one evaluator.
objections.planned_experiment: Compare B2, B6, B7, M3, and Ours-v2 on identical episodes and aggregation.
objections.dependency: Candidate adapters/runner, frozen features, unified evaluator.
objections.estimated_cost: B6: three 300-step replicates; B7: evaluation-only; M3 and Ours-v2: P0 budget.
objections.positive_response: Continuous coefficient prediction adds value beyond endpoint selection.
objections.negative_response: Narrow wording to reference-controlled garment wardrobe retrieval/control.

objections.reviewer_objection: One identity and five seen garments are too narrow.
objections.current_evidence: The protocol is fixed to one avatar and O01/O02/O03/O04/O08.
objections.missing_evidence: No expanded wardrobe or second identity is authorized.
objections.planned_experiment: No new experiment; perform a manuscript-wide fixed-scope audit.
objections.estimated_cost: Zero GPU; writing and audit only.
objections.positive_response: Defend the bounded representation/control question within its domain.
objections.negative_response: Frame the work as a fixed-avatar case study.

objections.reviewer_objection: The evaluation is view-transductive rather than strict view isolation.
objections.current_evidence: Prediction inputs are target-disjoint, but teachers, basis, and predictor fitting use all four views.
objections.missing_evidence: No strict-view result; canary remains blocked.
objections.planned_experiment: Disclosure closure; optional canary only through its separate authorization gate.
objections.positive_response: Retain precise reference-only-forward and view-transductive language.

objections.reviewer_objection: K=4 is the full centered rank, not strong compression.
objections.current_evidence: Five centered endpoints have maximum rank four.
objections.missing_evidence: Final K1-K4 rank ladder and representation diagnostics.
objections.planned_experiment: Run the fixed K1-K4 ladder with identical evaluation.
objections.estimated_cost: Four predefined ablation cells; no hyperparameter search.
objections.positive_response: Report the rank/fidelity tradeoff and call K4 complete.
objections.negative_response: Describe only a finite explicit endpoint basis.

objections.reviewer_objection: Per-garment teacher onboarding may erase practical benefit over lookup.
objections.current_evidence: Every registered garment requires a teacher; measured costs are not frozen.
objections.missing_evidence: Steps, time, VRAM, storage, basis, predictor, inference, and render costs.
objections.planned_experiment: Apply the efficiency/onboarding protocol to B2, B6, B7, and Ours-v2.
objections.estimated_cost: No additional optimization solely for logging.
objections.positive_response: State the measured conditions favoring coefficient control.
objections.negative_response: Acknowledge teacher storage/lookup as more economical.

objections.reviewer_objection: Replicate statistics may be misleading under deterministic initialization.
objections.current_evidence: Ours-v2 initial trainable state and output are identical across configured replicate seeds.
objections.missing_evidence: Final replicate outcomes and wording audit.
objections.planned_experiment: Run preregistered replicates and aggregate without best-run selection.
objections.estimated_cost: Already included in the P0 run budget.
objections.negative_response: Report individual replicates or a deterministic aggregate.
objections.claim_to_remove: Three independent seeds or random-initialization robustness.

objections.reviewer_objection: Reference control may be dominated by garment color.
objections.planned_experiment: Run preregistered color-preserving and color-disrupting counterfactuals without fitting weights.
objections.positive_response: State which non-color signals remain predictive.
objections.negative_response: State that control is primarily driven by appearance/color cues.

objections.reviewer_objection: LPIPS, silhouette IoU, and boundary metrics are missing.
objections.current_evidence: Historical core metrics exist; extended metrics are not final.
objections.missing_evidence: Resource-verified LPIPS and fixed-threshold silhouette/boundary evaluation.
objections.planned_experiment: Evaluate all main methods episode-first, outfit-macro, then replicate aggregate.
objections.dependency: Frozen renders, masks, and approved LPIPS resource.
objections.positive_response: Report perceptual, silhouette, and boundary evidence.
objections.negative_response: Qualify pixel-metric gains and show boundary failures.

objections.reviewer_objection: Gaussian spatial artifacts are not quantified.
objections.missing_evidence: Displacement, support, opacity, boundary, protected-region, and blinded-grade diagnostics.
objections.planned_experiment: Apply the frozen spatial-artifact protocol to teacher, old Ours, A6, Ours-v2, and any authorized pilot.
objections.dependency: Residuals, masks, normals, renders, manual review.
objections.positive_response: Quantify where residual control contains artifacts.
objections.negative_response: Disclose artifact modes and remove clean-boundary language.
objections.claim_to_remove: Unqualified spatial faithfulness or artifact reduction.

objections.current_evidence: O07 is a fixed failure and was excluded from fitting.
objections.planned_experiment: Evaluate the four fixed stages without O07 tuning.
objections.positive_response: Localize the limitation while retaining only the seen-wardrobe claim.
objections.negative_response: Attribute teacher-side failure to support/capacity and narrow discussion further.
objections.claim_to_remove: Any implication that the basis handles O07.

objections.reviewer_objection: Historical B5 has an ambiguous architecture/supervision contract.
objections.current_evidence: B5 is complex RF-F plus SmoothL1 and rejected pairwise geometry, so it is off-matrix.
objections.planned_experiment: Run paired M3/M4 with shared trunks and zero-output heads; keep B5 historical.
objections.estimated_cost: Six 300-step runs across M3 and M4.
objections.positive_response: Use only M3/M4 for causal interpretation.
objections.claim_to_remove: Any conclusion that treats B5 as M3 or M4.

objections.current_evidence: Historical cells change both architecture and supervision.
objections.planned_experiment: Cross linear/complex fusion with corrected/legacy supervision under matched output semantics.
objections.positive_response: Attribute only interactions supported by the matrix.
objections.negative_response: Use the narrower supervision-critical, linear-sufficient/economical wording if supported.
objections.claim_to_remove: Intrinsic linear superiority or complex-fusion failure.

objections.reviewer_objection: Synthetic targets may not transfer to real imagery.
objections.current_evidence: The present evaluation does not establish unconstrained real-world behavior.
objections.missing_evidence: Preregistered real capture or external reference study.
objections.planned_experiment: Future external-reference study after provenance and masks are frozen.
objections.positive_response: Report bounded robustness in an appendix.
objections.negative_response: Retain the synthetic-to-real gap as a limitation.

objections.current_evidence: All assets belong to one fixed identity.
objections.planned_experiment: No pre-submission experiment; reserve for post-submission research.
objections.dependency: New identity assets, teachers, basis, predictor, and evaluation.

objections.reviewer_objection: Finite support may fail on loose garments.
objections.current_evidence: O07 and cloud/boundary concerns are consistent with support and displacement limits.
objections.missing_evidence: Frozen spatial diagnostics and a fixed seen-garment regularization pilot.
objections.planned_experiment: O03 plus O08 trust-region teacher micro-pilot; exclude O07 from tuning.
objections.dependency: Explicit authorization and a separate output root.
objections.estimated_cost: Two fixed experimental teacher variants plus controls; benchmark before execution.
objections.positive_response: Report mitigation only for the selected seen garments.
objections.negative_response: Seal the failure and reserve support expansion for future work.
